# Vendored

`rxjs-7.8.2.umd.min.js` is `package/dist/bundles/rxjs.umd.min.js` from the npm
tarball <https://registry.npmjs.org/rxjs/-/rxjs-7.8.2.tgz>, unmodified, with its
licence (`rxjs-LICENSE.txt`, Apache-2.0). The tarball's integrity was checked
against the registry before extraction:

    sha512-dhKf903U/PQZY6boNNtAGdWbG85WAbjT/1xYoZIC7FAY0yWapOBQVsVrDl58W86//e1VpMNBtRV4MaXfdMySFA==

It is vendored, not fetched from a CDN, because the KD240 sits on a shop
network that may have no internet, and so the page needs no build step.
